question: For the primary collision factor violation category that was the most common cause of traffic accidents in 2021, how many percentage points did its share of annual road incidents in 2021 decrease compared to its share in 2011?

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.pcf_violation_category AS cat,
         ci.db_year AS yr,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM collisions c
  JOIN case_ids ci ON c.case_id = ci.case_id
  WHERE ci.db_year IN (2021, 2011)
  GROUP BY c.pcf_violation_category, ci.db_year
),
tot AS (
  SELECT yr, SUM(cnt) AS total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY yr
),
top2021 AS (
  SELECT cat
  FROM base
  WHERE yr = 2021
  ORDER BY cnt DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
shares AS (
  SELECT b.cat,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2021 THEN b.cnt * 100.0 / t.total ELSE 0 END) AS s2021,
         SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr = 2011 THEN b.cnt * 100.0 / t.total ELSE 0 END) AS s2011
  FROM base b
  JOIN tot t ON b.yr = t.yr
  WHERE b.cat = (SELECT cat FROM top2021)
  GROUP BY b.cat
)
SELECT s2011 - s2021 AS decrease_pp
FROM shares

  SELECT pcf_violation_category AS cat,
         substr(collision_date,1,4) AS yr,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt

  WHERE substr(collision_date,1,4) IN ('2021','2011')
  GROUP BY pcf_violation_category, substr(collision_date,1,4)
),
tot AS (
  SELECT yr, SUM(cnt) AS total FROM base GROUP BY yr
),
top2021 AS (
  SELECT cat FROM base WHERE yr='2021' ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1
),
shares AS (

         SUM(CASE WHEN b.yr='2011' THEN b.cnt*100.0/t.total END) AS s2011
  FROM base b
  JOIN tot t ON b.yr=t.yr
  WHERE b.cat=(SELECT cat FROM top2021)
  GROUP BY b.cat
)
SELECT s2021 - s2011 AS decrease_pp
FROM shares
